001package org.clafer.javascript;
002
003/**
004 *
005 * @author jimmy
006 */
007public class JavascriptException extends RuntimeException {
008
009    public JavascriptException() {
010    }
011
012    public JavascriptException(String message) {
013        super(message);
014    }
015
016    public JavascriptException(Throwable cause) {
017        super(cause);
018    }
019
020    public JavascriptException(String message, Throwable cause) {
021        super(message, cause);
022    }
023}
